providerVisibleStructuralRules: Include at least one block definition.
`association`, `composition`, `generalization`, and `dependency` each require two existing Block endpoints.
`generalization` connects a child source Block to a parent target Block.
`composition` connects a part source Block to a whole target Block.
`dependency` connects a dependent source Block to a supplier target Block.
Note attachments use `commentLink`; `commentLink` is excluded from structural Block-endpoint and connectivity rules.
